notes.title: My first short film "Don't Cry over Spilt Eggnog" is now available on Steam
notes.content:
Earlier this year I directed my first budgeted short film, and it is now available for purchase on Steam for .99 cents http://store.steampowered.com/app/751860/Dont_Cry_over_Spilt_Eggnog/

"Don't Cry over Spilt Eggnog" is a story about a mysterious homeless man named Jarvis, who really loves eggnog, thinks he is going to visit his loving sister Tracey at her trailer for a Christmas get together. When Jarvis arrives he is confronted with a good spirited intervention to try to help him get off of the streets, but his bitchy sister Charlie ruins the occasion and things take a turn for the strange.

notes.title: "The Grandfather" IndieGoGo is now LIVE
notes.content:
I have launched the IndieGoGo campaign for my next game "The Grandfather", which is coming in spring/summer 2016 for PC/MAC/PS4. 

View the IndieGoGo campaign here: https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/the-grandfather--2/x/5229043#/ 

The campaign features some one of a kind and limited perks, including the Autoharp that the soundtrack was recorded on, and a special edition of the game with 20 wallpapers and two different versions of the unique soundtrack. 

“The Grandfather” is collaboration from the creator of “Fingerbones” http://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=David%20Szymanski and the creator of “The Lady”; both devs thrive at creating hauntingly rich atmospheres with a mix of visuals, audio, and a different approach to storytelling. The game tells its story through the use of comic book pages and narration/voice acting. The Grandfather features all hand drawn art by amazing comic book artist SaintYak http://saintyak.deviantart.com/gallery/  , and a procedural soundtrack composed by Michael Patrick Rogers https://soundcloud.com/mprart-1 , which is created by the user as they play the game.

Get "The Grandfather" for just $5 while the early bird perk lasts, and check out some of ther other limited perks as well. 

Thank you to all who enjoyed and supported "The Lady", if you thought that was a weird game, then wait until you play "The Grandfather".

notes.title: "The Grandfather" DEMO now available for Download
notes.content:
The DEMO for my upcoming game "The Grandfather" is now available for download at the following places (PC & MAC)

GameJolt (search "The Grandfather, Steam keeps blanking out my link)

itchio http://mpr-art-hallucinations.itch.io/thegrandfatherdemo

IndieDB http://www.indiedb.com/games/the-grandfather/downloads

Steam Coming later this week

"The Grandfather" is a collaboration from the creators of "The Lady" and "Fingerbones"

"The Grandfather" is a unique Story Driven Point and Click puzzle/horror Game, presented in a pop-up storybook, comic book art style, with narration by a voice actress. The Game tells the tale of an old man who is tormented by the coldness of his wife. The Grandfather is a combination of exploration and point and click elements, and features a procedural soundtrack that is created by the user as they play the game.

This is a Pre-Alpha DEMO and does not fully represent the finished game, an IndieGoGo campaign launches on October 3rd!!

Be sure to follow "The Grandfather" on Twitter @GrandfatherGame for updates on the development of the game. "The Grandfather" is expected to release in spring 2016 on PC/MAC and shortly after on PS4.

notes.title: "The Lady" Noisecore Soundtrack Available on Bandcamp
notes.content:
One of the main "characters" in "The Lady" is the soundtrack, it helps complete the atmosphere of the game. The majority of the soundtrack was made on a Tascam 144 Four Track back in 1997 using various instruments. You can find a picture of the Four Track this soundtrack was recorded on in the "Artwork" section of the game Community.
If you're familiar with/a fan of Noisecore music then you will hopefully enjoy the soundtrack.

You can purchase The Lady Soundtrack (Full) here for $1:

http://michaelpatrickrogers.bandcamp.com/album/the-lady-soundtrack-full

notes.title: Help Support "The Lady" THUNDERCLAP
notes.content:
I have started a THUNDERCLAP to help get the word out on the release day of The Lady. 

Support The Lady THUNDERCLAP here: https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/20917-the-lady-releasing-on-steam?locale=en

For those unfamiliar with THUNDERCLAP, it's similar to Kickstarter, except there's no money or rewards involved. You simply select which social media netowork of yours (Facebook, Twitter, Tmblr) you'd like to help share the message on, and on the end date the message goes out to each supporters network reach, but only IF the supporter goal is reached.

I need 100 supporters for my message to go out, right now I am at 34% and have 14 days left.
